title: PLUS THERAPEUTICS, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: Plus Therapeutics, Inc. (PSTV), a micro-cap biotech listed on Nasdaq Capital Market, filed an 8-K disclosing that its drug candidate REYOBIQ (rhenium Re186 obisbemeda) received FDA Orphan Drug Designation for pediatric malignant gliomas. This is a routine Item 8.01 disclosure under Regulation FD.
